criteria.text: Implement the authoritative neutral package API, strict Pydantic contracts, deterministic generated-schema exporter, shared Python/TypeScript vectors and Ajv validation, plus the shared principal/caller gates. Keep neutral execution metadata separate from analytics judgment and use the frozen field definitions.

Wire real controller/context, source, catalog, and viewer request callers through the shared principal gateways; connect the default worker launch to the neutral adapter; remove inherited factory product discovery/default-viewer surfaces and the dangling skill installer while preserving the build orchestrator and accepted specifications. Rewrite the root README, produce the inspectable local demo and transitional-behavior inventory, and test that inventory against the active fixture. Node 001 solely owns src/commands/index.ts: remove factory registration, add an analytics command trampoline with a computed lazy import of ../analytics/cli.js and explicit unavailable behavior until 003 supplies analyticsCmd(argv, cmd); do not swallow unrelated import/handler errors. 003 must not edit the registry.

Run the same frozen neutral vectors through the extracted package and legacy adapter, then generate a local archive and digest from the actual package bytes. Keep the conformance suite in tests/conformance.test.ts and the package test script wired to it. Exercise a live orphan parent with a descendant and verify both PIDs are terminated by recovery on Windows; process.ts is owned by this unit for that scoped fix. Do not publish remotely or change build-runner retry policy.

Run every feature acceptance including three live gpt-6-luna/xhigh worker starts with distinct questions, caller-level access checks, disabled retry/review/repair/fallback, README and transitional-inventory checks, the T53 checkout/context discovery-path search, contract vectors, neutral compatibility and local archive digest. Write verification.md with actual evidence for all FRs, SCs, Edge Cases and T53; include SC-006/FR-007 inventory evidence and leave accepted contracts unchanged. Coordinator-authorized recovery scope: repair the real live-worker acceptance command and its context-launch adapter as necessary. Launch three actual codex gpt-6-luna/xhigh model workers sequentially through the controller with distinct neutral questions and preserve exact supplied context, raw first responses, command argv, exit status, model/version, timestamps and digests. A synthetic Node process or model metadata alone is not live-worker evidence. Keep ordinary acceptance deterministic; acceptance:001:live must execute and verify the real model-response demonstration or verify previously recorded immutable responses with explicit provenance, never silently substitute synthetic output. Complete SC-005/EC-004 using actual evidence for both product execution paths consuming the same authoritative neutral package; the upstream lightweight-dag checkout may be read or exercised for this proof but must not be modified by this worker. Add only these scoped fixes and evidence; preserve the feature requirements, policy, task wording, frozen schemas, and analytical no-retry behavior.

Implement deterministic synthetic fixture IDs and digests, worker/reference separation, explicit source/grant profiles, answer limits and rubrics, planted-fault variants, and the exact 150-card/20-query/5-no-match, 99-file, and 48-signal cohorts. Freeze development/evaluation case roles into evaluator-only fixture-set digests, exclude roles from worker payloads, and preserve tuning exposure; include at least 20 evaluation-role question cases, and do not relabel a tuned development case as evaluation in the same fixture-set version. Preserve proposal-case ownership and do not tune labels from product output.
